scenes.narration: Every live biotherapeutic starts with the same gamble: a peptide designed by guesswork. Cozy Peptide replaces the guesswork. Name the disease — get a novel AI-designed peptide, screened for safety, compiled to DNA, ready for engineered bacteria to brew locally. Watch one get designed, live.
Start with a real target: C. difficile gut infection. One click selects it — the designer picks the best scaffold and bacterial factory for the job: a hairpin peptide brewed in E. coli Nissle.

scenes.narration: Meta AI reads the literature, drafts candidates, then revises them against safety, chassis, and biocontainment checks — every step streaming on screen. Watch the status feed: literature grounding, candidate drafting, verification, chassis matching — each check logged as it lands. The symbolic compiler proves every claim before anything ships: no guesswork survives this pipeline. Each revision cites its sources, so the final report reads like a lab notebook, not a black box.

scenes.narration: And the guardrails are real. Ask for a toxin and the same server-side blocklist refuses — try it live, right on the page. No toxins, no pathogens, no synthesis protocols for flagged sequences. Safety isn't a filter here; it's the compiler.

Then the loop closes. The Lab Guide walks any wet lab from DNA order to assay results — culture, induction, harvest, assay. Or preview the whole thing with zero setup in demo mode, end to end, feeding results back into the next design.
